title: Cross-chart geometry morph
intent: Stress keyed spring motion by morphing the same data between bars, a rose, a donut, and packed bubbles.

ai.create: Create a motion lab where stable keyed data morphs between Cartesian bars, radial rose sectors, donut sectors, and packed bubbles using a shared path topology.
ai.maintain: Keep every datum keyed across modes, preserve the fixed path sample count, and verify that an interrupted spring carries path-token velocity into the next chart form.
